spans.s:
आढक mfn. (-कः-की-का-कं) A measure of grain equal to four Prasthas
or containing nearly 7lbs. 11 oz. avoirdupois: in Bengal an
Araka is equal to two mons or 164lbs. avds.
 f. (-की)
 1. A kind
of pulse, (Cytisus cajan.)
 2. A fragrant earth: see तुवरी.
 E. आङ्,
ढोक to go, irregularly अच्, fem. ङीप् or टाप् with इक् inserted.

आढकिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
 1. Sown with an Āḍhaka of seed, (a field,
&c.)
 2. Holding or containing the same.
 E. आढक the measure, and
ठञ् aff.

आढकीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) See the preceding.
 E. आढक, ख aff.
